stopGap.retirementTrigger: Retire once TARGET Norn authoring (concept({ ... }), pinned packs) hosts the feature ontology natively in a Norn cell.

title: Norn Studio UI Surface
summary: All Studio UI routes in `apps/studio/src/lib/pages.ts` & `routes.tsx`: home shell, sources & records explorer, transforms, decisions & runs, import triage, learning loop, metrics/questions, dashboards, views, workflows, semantic map, canvas, rules, markings, and connections.

features.title: Studio dashboards and declarative views editor

probe.drive: Launch Studio over a local `norn dev` cell (`cd apps/studio && bun run build && bun run local --project <proj> --port <port>`), visit `/dashboards`, `/dashboards/new`, `/views`, and `/views/new`, create and reopen a dashboard/view, or run `cd apps/studio && bunx playwright test e2e/dashboards.e2e.ts e2e/views.e2e.ts`.
probe.observableEndState: Dashboards and views render live data through `/api/host`, save/edit flows persist across reload, and missing IDs show honest unavailable states rather than blank screens.
gotchas: Never open Studio directly against a shared production cell; always bind `bun run local` to a disposable loopback `norn dev` project.

features.title: Studio decisions inbox and workflow run detail

probe.drive: Open `/decisions` as reviewer (`bun run local --project <proj> --as reviewer --port <port>`), inspect a pending approval in the floating DetailSheet, decide it, and open `/runs/$id` (or run `e2e/decisions.e2e.ts` and `e2e/approved-run.e2e.ts`).
probe.observableEndState: Pending decisions list honestly, reviewer decision records receipt and transitions the run state on `/runs/$id`, and self-approval shows the cell's refusal banner.
gotchas: The requester cannot approve their own pending decision; run a second `bun run local --as reviewer` instance on a separate loopback port.

features.title: Studio home overview, shell navigation, markings, and connections

probe.drive: Open `/`, `/markings`, and `/connections` against a local `norn dev` cell, toggle dock/sidebar navigation, verify `/api/me` session identity, or run `e2e/home.e2e.ts`, `e2e/nav.e2e.ts`, and `e2e/markings.e2e.ts`.
probe.observableEndState: Home shell renders with domain-agnostic ShellCard + StatWell hierarchy, markings page reflects declared privacy policies, and connections page lists configured connectors and tool bindings.
gotchas: Legacy URLs `/questions` and `/guarantees` redirect to `/metrics` and `/rules` (`MOVED` in `routes.tsx`).

features.title: Studio import triage and quarantined finding review

probe.drive: Visit `/imports` on a cell seeded with import findings (`e2e/import-triage-cell.ts`), inspect quarantined rows and crosswalk mismatches, or run `cd apps/studio && bunx playwright test e2e/import-triage.e2e.ts`.
probe.observableEndState: Quarantined records display exact `DataQualityFinding` diagnostics and provenance; unmapped rows never silently promote into authoritative ontology records.
gotchas: CSV upload preview must preserve exact string values for decimal quantities and dates.

features.title: Studio learning episodes, cases, misfit analysis, and proposals

probe.drive: Navigate `/learning/episodes`, `/episodes/$id`, `/learning/cases`, `/learning/misfit`, `/learning/proposals`, and `/learning/proposals/$id`, or run `cd apps/studio && bunx playwright test e2e/episodes.e2e.ts e2e/learning-cases.e2e.ts e2e/learning-misfit.e2e.ts e2e/learning-proposals.e2e.ts`.
probe.observableEndState: Learning surfaces display recorded episodes, case clusters, misfit evidence, and proposed definition changes gated behind governed review.
gotchas: Proposals remain drafts until admitted and installed through the governed definition lifecycle; never auto-activate.

features.title: Studio metrics catalog, question builder, and question tree

probe.drive: Open `/metrics`, `/metrics/new`, `/metrics/build`, and `/metrics/$name`, construct a question over a live object type, inspect its answer and numeric trace, or run `e2e/metrics-builder.e2e.ts` and `e2e/question-save.e2e.ts`.
probe.observableEndState: Metrics list matches `GET /v1/questions:metrics`, builder saves admitted question definitions, and `/metrics/$name` renders exact totals with contribution traces.
gotchas: Verify `/questions` still redirects cleanly to `/metrics` for saved bookmarks.

features.title: Studio sources, concept explorer, records grid, and record detail

probe.drive: Open `/sources`, click into `/sources/$concept` and `/sources/$concept/$` record detail (plus `/objects/$type` grid), execute an available action from the record page, or run `e2e/records-explorer.e2e.ts`, `e2e/records-grid.e2e.ts`, and `e2e/record-page.e2e.ts`.
probe.observableEndState: Grid paginates/filters live objects, record detail renders properties/links/lineage/history and honest refusal panels, and mutations refresh live views over `/api/host/v1/subscribe`.
gotchas: `/sources/$concept` is intentionally served by `/sources/$concept/$` with an empty splat (`SERVED_BY` in `apps/studio/src/lib/pages.ts`).

features.title: Studio transforms, workflows, semantic map, canvas, and rules

probe.drive: Open `/transforms`, `/transforms/$id`, `/workflows`, `/map`, `/canvas`, and `/rules` with WASM checker built (`apps/studio/src/checker`), or run `e2e/transforms.e2e.ts`, `e2e/workflows.e2e.ts`, `e2e/semantic-map.e2e.ts`, and `e2e/rules.e2e.ts`.
probe.observableEndState: Transforms show plan/rows/lineage; canvas and rules run the real Rust WASM checker in-browser (flagging stuck states on deleted lifecycle steps) rather than faking admission in TypeScript.
gotchas: Canvas and decision-admission tests require the built WASM checker (`NORN_CHECKER_WASM_REQUIRED=1`); a missing WASM bundle must fail loudly, never skip.
